item.title: Printer recommendation in Berlin for stationery items?
item.description:
I am creating printed pieces for a workshop to be held in a few months in Berlin and need to get several stationery items created (like notepads.) Does anyone have a good Berlin printer recommendation for notepads, offset printing, etc.?

Thank you in advance!
